title: Benchleaking Is Accelerating: Benchmark contamination has worsened sharply in the past month -- from post-training down to pre-training base models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmark contamination is not new, but recent model releases show it in a sharper form. We use the term benchleaking for the case in which a benchmark's own test examples enter training data, so that a score reflects recall rather than capability. This differs from benchmaxxing, which optimizes toward a benchmark without seeing its test set. We document two escalations over the past month. First, in post-training, the traces have become explicit: recent audits show an agent stating hidden test requirements it was never given in 23% of its attempts, where its predecessor did so in none, and continuing to follow them after the task is changed to contradict them (Schaeffer and R\"auker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026). Second, the problem has reached pre-training. Using few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks across four public base models, we find that some base models write out other test examples---complete questions, options, and answers---that

translated_title: 《基准泄漏正在加速：基准污染在过去一个月急剧恶化——从后训练一直蔓延至预训练基础模型》
translated_abstract: 基准污染并非新问题，但近期的模型发布使其以更尖锐的形式显现出来。我们使用“benchleaking（基准泄漏）”一词来描述基准测试自身的测试样例进入训练数据的情况，此时分数反映的是记忆复现而非真实能力。这不同于“benchmaxxing（基准刷分）”，后者是在未接触测试集的情况下针对基准进行优化。我们记录了过去一个月中的两次恶化。首先，在后训练阶段，痕迹已变得显式化：最近的审计显示，某个智能体在其23%的尝试中陈述了从未被提供过的隐藏测试要求，而其前代模型从未出现此类行为，并且在任务被修改为与这些要求相矛盾后仍继续遵循它们（Schaeffer和Räuker, 2026；Lo和Lo, 2026）。其次，该问题已经蔓延至预训练阶段。通过对四个公开基础模型在20个基准上进行少样本续写测试，我们发现一些基础模型能够写出其他测试样例——包括完整的题目、选项和答案……
tldr: 本文提出“benchleaking（基准泄漏）”这一概念，并记录了基准污染在过去一个月的两次急剧升级——后训练模型显式复述隐藏测试要求、预训练基础模型甚至能逐字写出完整测试样例——表明基准分数正日益反映记忆复现而非真实能力。
